Question ID: USH_U06_L03_GuidedPractice_Q01

MLA Standard: SS.912.A.7.14, SS.912.H.3.1

Stimulus: global economy data table

Historical ContextEvidence DetailReasoning Task
The United States in the global economy involves trade agreements, international competition, outsourcing, labor change, technology, environmental concerns, and cultural diffusion.Trade agreements and global markets can create lower prices and new markets while increasing competition for workers and businesses.Explain context and evidence without drifting outside SS.912.A.7.14, SS.912.H.3.1.

Question: Which conclusion is best supported by the evidence detail? (United States in the Global Economy)

generalfeedback.text: Use the stimulus, identify the evidence, explain the reasoning, and check the mapped standard before finalizing your answer.

answer.text: Trade agreements and global markets can create lower prices and new markets while increasing competition for workers and businesses. This evidence matters because it shows this relationship: Outsourcing and automation changed manufacturing, service work, wages, and regional economies.

feedback.text: Correct. This answer uses the stimulus evidence, explains the context and evidence relationship, and stays inside United States in the Global Economy and SS.912.A.7.14, SS.912.H.3.1.

answer.text: The student should repeat the topic "United States in the Global Economy" but avoid explaining the evidence detail from the stimulus.

feedback.text: This is incomplete. A title is not evidence. A valid answer must use the stimulus and explain how the detail supports United States in the Global Economy.

answer.text: The student should list this detail, "Trade agreements and global markets can create lower prices and new markets while increasing competition for workers and businesses," and stop without explaining cause, consequence, comparison, or significance.

feedback.text: This is incomplete. Listing a detail is not mastery; the student must explain how the evidence proves the mapped historical relationship.

answer.text: Environmental and labor concerns emerged when production crossed national borders is related to the lesson, but it is incomplete unless the answer explains the specific stimulus detail in the question. It is incorrect to describe globalization as only good or only bad. Explain benefits, costs, and affected groups
